evals.name: classify-extension-by-lowest-level
evals.prompt: My extension uses only released APIs except for one direct read from an SAP database table. What clean core level applies, and what would move it toward Level A?
evals.expected_output: Applies the lowest-level rule and classifies the extension as Level C due to direct SAP table read; recommends replacing it with a released API such as an appropriate released CDS view to move toward Level A.

evals.name: route-atc-migration-project
evals.prompt: Plan a multi-step migration of our legacy custom code using ATC findings, prioritizing Level D and Level C remediation and deciding whether to retire or renovate the code.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that this is a code migration/remediation workflow and routes to abap-cloud-migration rather than stopping at a conceptual explanation of clean core levels.
